coder_notes: The registry's arm-to-intervention mapping appears swapped (active comparator arm lists 'Drug: Administration of L-TC'; experimental arm lists 'Other: Radiotherapy plus Temozolomide'); coded by arm titles, so L-TC is in the experimental arm only and temozolomide in both. Active moiety: no INN given in record; 'transcrocetin' used as written (liposomal trans-crocetin), formulation_flag new_formulation for the liposomal form. Hypoxia imaging markers are imaging-only (not molecular), so not listed as a biomarker; used as evidence of an imaging pharmacodynamic endpoint (target_engagement yes), though the link to L-TC is implied only via the 'Hypoxia' keyword.
